input.read_as: Pillow RGB original dimensions; no EXIF transpose/global upscale
input.source_manifest: Caller-provided local ten-image manifest with id/file/sha256/width/height; private inputs not distributed

detector.max_candidates: no explicit cap in version1.1.0 bitmap_to_boxes; all contours inspected

recognizer.architecture: docTR PARSeq, not upstream baudm implementation
recognizer.vocabulary: official french, includes English; no whitelist

coordinates.mapping: docTR DetectionPredictor removes symmetric padding; exported normalized x*original_width and y*original_height
coordinates.raw_detector_unit_warning: word boxes not directly comparable to Paddle line-box recall

resources.shared_lock: Caller-provided shared local lock path via CLI

failure_policy: Retain completed images; explicit empty/error rows for remaining originals; full ten-image denominator; no rerun/parameter tuning.
diagnostics: Same forward only. Keep official raw export, post-DB detector words, split-rec-crop text/confidence and EOS presence. EOS missing is recorded, never repaired. Observational hooks included in timing.
scope: Local research comparison only; not browser deployment or M4 timing, not commercial licensing determination; no weights redistribution, no remote code, no third-party image transmission.
timing_scope: single_pass includes local RGB decode, preprocessing, forward, hooks and projection; excludes raw JSON write, initialization and lock wait. No warm repeats.

preflight_compatibility_fix.reason: Official PyPI distribution metadata is1.1.0 but verified wheel doctr/version.py declares v1.1.0; corrected exact package+module version assertions only. No model parameter or image changes.

public_copy_note: Paths and private input hash removed from metadata only; engine.py/run_eval.py/summarize_results.py byte-identical to the v2 local run, not a new inference run.
